items.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023
items.q: I met some serious older musicians who had been playing in Sydney and they were like, one of them an absolutely great jazz pianist, Dave McRae.

ctx.x: Well said. Did it take you time or did you figure out on your own what C 7 and F major 7 and all those symbols meant?

Yeah I figured all that out. But then as I was meeting friends who were musicians and I met some serious older musicians who had been playing in Sydney and they were like, one of them an absolutely great jazz pianist, Dave McRae. Dave became, through a chain of circumstances, Buddy Rich’s piano player in the ‘70s and Buddy’s favorite pianist. Dave could groove like mad. But I think he’s retired from all of that. So there were these — Mike Nock is another pretty famous New Zealander but he went in the (whatever…
I want to pursue that for a moment. The feeling, ‘cause I think I know what you mean, is it about swing?
